# Toast

Light, dismissible feedback for results and reminders.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="toast" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'neutral' | 'success' | Status meaning; the title must state the result too, not rely on color alone |
| `open` | boolean | false | Updated through v-model:open |
| `title` | string | Required | Notification title |
| `description` | string | undefined | Supporting text |
| `duration` | number | 5000 | Time before it closes automatically (ms) |
| `closeLabel` | string | '关闭通知' | Accessible name of the close button |
| `regionLabel` | string | '通知（F8）' | Accessible name of the notification region; mention the F8 shortcut |

### Events

- `update:open(boolean)`

## Keyboard and usage notes

F8 focuses the notification region; Escape or the close button dismisses it. The countdown pauses on hover or focus. Use one AgmToast per app.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmToast } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```
